license.note: Pyodide is MPL-2.0; the bundled CPython standard library is PSF-2.0.

python-worker.js.note: first-party classic worker (extension/lib/python-host.js spawns it per run); pinned here so the build verifies every staged byte.

admission.record: extension/lib/python-runtime.js exports the identical sha256 pins (PYTHON_RUNTIME_PIN) — tests assert wasm-tools/python/MANIFEST.json, the shipped pins, and the on-disk bytes all agree.
admission.distCopy: build.mjs verifies the on-disk bytes against this manifest, then copies the runtime + python-worker.js into extension/dist/wasm-tools/python/ (dist is the packaged, generated-artifact tree; the raw third-party glue is never shipped as scanned source).
admission.note: kmpq (by-reference): the runtime bytes are large (~13.7 MB) and are NOT folded into the bounded WASI tool-bundle CAS lane (extension/wasm/cas + bundled inventory) — they ship as one content-addressed-by-manifest blob set, referenced by the pins above, executed under a separate dispatcher (python-worker.js), never through the WASI host.
